Susume! Kinopio Taichou.name: Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker
Susume! Kinopio Taichou.summary: The intrepid Captain Toad sets off on his own adventure for the very first time through a wide variety of tricky, enemy-infested, maze-like stages to find hidden gems and nab elusive gold stars.
developers: Nintendo EAD Software Development Group No.2
